title: Print Hello, World!
instruction: Write a `print()` statement that outputs **Hello, World!** exactly as shown.

title: Print your name
instruction: Write a `print()` statement that outputs **your name** to the screen. You can use any name you like.

title: Print with single quotes
instruction: Use **single quotes** to print the greeting **Greetings, Earthling!** to the screen.
starter_code: # Use single quotes for the string

title: Print two separate lines
instruction: Use two `print()` statements to output your **first name** on the first line and your **last name** on the second line.

title: Print your favorite color
instruction: Print your favorite color by writing it as a string inside `print()`. Use either double or single quotes — your choice.
